facts.text: Apps should use guided experience components to help users set up app functionality smoothly and frictionlessly
Setup objects are registered as guided experience items by calling relevant functions in guided experience codeunit
Only one primary setup object allowed per app; multiple setup objects can exist but only one designated as primary
Just-in-time setup defers some configuration to when user needs specific app actions instead of doing all upfront
App installation wizard automatically provisions marketplace apps and offers option to run primary setup
Teaching tips educate users about key concepts and actions to ensure good first-run experience with app
